channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about JJ Redick | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about JJ Redick from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on JJ Redick
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on JJ Redick:

“I first got to know him when he was doing TV because of production meetings. I've had sit downs with him and enjoyed my time with him. Have kept in light contact with him since he was given the job. I think he's done an exceptional job in a high-profile market.”

Mark Daigneault on JJ Redick, May 2, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on JJ Redick
item.description:
Deandre Ayton on how he handles JJ Redick calling out the teams effort in losses:

“I feel like when i'm not doing what i'm supposed to do, it's contagious. I be hard on myself especially when JJ is upset because when it comes to that effort on multiple plays, i'm one of those guys he is definitely talking too. I take pride in that”

Deandre Ayton on JJ Redick, Apr 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rich Paul on JJ Redick, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Rich Paul on JJ Redick and Luka Doncic going at it on the sidelines:

“That leads to a healthy relationship. That means there’s a profound respect for the player and should be a profound respect for the coach. It ultimately leads to a healthy relationship….When things happen in such a media robust environment we’re looking for the drama of it all. The reality of it is, these guys are getting paid a lot of money to do a high level job, the fact that there’s care shown, passion shown, and competitive nature shown, I think that’s healthy”

Rich Paul on JJ Redick, Luka Doncic, Mar 2, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Malone on JJ Redick
item.description:
“I saw a picture of JJ Redick, I feel for him. He’s got that thousand-mile stare.”

Michael Malone on JJ Redick, Jan 8, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: LeBron James on JJ Redick
item.description:
Extended thoughts from LeBron on JJ Redick:

“I think whatever happens, JJ will continue to grow. Thought he had a hell of a rookie campaign ... it’s a hell of a lot harder being a rookie head coach coaching the Lakers. A whole other ballgame. I thought he handled it extremely well. Thought he learned every single day, held us accountable, pushed us. I thought JJ and his coaching staff were great throughout the whole season. That’s one thing for sure - we have a great, up and coming coach that will be great for many years.”

LeBron James on JJ Redick, May 1, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Luka Doncic on JJ Redick
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Luka Doncic on JJ Redick:

“I think he’s a hell of a coach. Not many coaches do the stuff he did in his first year. I’m really glad (he coached me).Feels sometimes like I’m back in Europe a little bit. We have a great bond … it’s been nothing but amazing.”

Luka Doncic on JJ Redick, May 1, 2025. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Austin Reaves on JJ Redick
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Austin Reaves on JJ Redick:

“He’s been huge in what we’ve done, and I can’t give him enough credit … (I’m) happy to go to war for him any day.”

Austin Reaves on JJ Redick, Apr 12, 2025. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: LeBron James on JJ Redick
item.description:
James on Redick:

“He breathes the game. And he breathes the game of basketball every single day … He's a dickhead, and I love it.”

LeBron James on JJ Redick, Mar 26, 2025. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Anthony Davis on JJ Redick
item.description:
“And the same thing defensively. Obviously, it’s going to grow and we’re going to integrate more things within that. But I think it’s a good first step of seeing how (Redick) wants me to play and how he wants me to be that hub and to orchestrate the offense, in a sense.”

Anthony Davis on JJ Redick, Oct 24, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Bronny James on JJ Redick
item.description:
Bronny James on his early impressions of coach JJ Redick:

“He's a great coach so far. Been amazing vibes in the facility so far so I feel likeit's upped the vibes from what it was last year from what I've heard.”

Bronny James on JJ Redick, Oct 5, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bronny James on JJ Redick
item.description:
Bronny James on early impressions with JJ Redick:

“He's a great coach so far. Been amazing vibes in the facility so far so I feel like it's upped the vibes from what it was last year from what I've heard.”

Bronny James on JJ Redick, Oct 4, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rui Hachimura on JJ Redick
item.description:
Rui Hachimura on JJ Redick:

“He was just in the league … he knows exactly what’s happening in the league right now. For us, it’s easy to understand … whatever he says just makes sense.”

Rui Hachimura on JJ Redick, Oct 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Phil Jackson, JJ Redick, Pat Riley
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“I was fortunate enough to play for coaches like Phil Jackson and Pat Riley. When you have coaches like that, you listen. When Phil Jackson tells you to run a play, you do it because you’ve seen him win six championships. You know he knows what he’s talking about. Butwhen you get a young coach who hasn’t won anything, there’s a different level of respect. You might think, 'I’m a better player than this guy ever was. Why should I listen to him?' That’s what I think the Lakers are going to face with JJ Redick. LeBron and AD will keep everyone in line, but I think it’s going to be tough for a young coach to get that level of respect from veteran players.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Phil Jackson, JJ Redick, Pat Riley, Sep 7, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on JJ Redick
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal on JJ Redick's hiring:

“It makes it look crazy that a guy with no experience can overshadow a guy like Sam Cassellwho's been in the league 15 years, this and that. So just let me say that, no disrespect to JJ, but I think Sam should also be able to get the same looks. But I'm happy for JJ. Lot of pressure. Winning games will not be good enough. Expectation when you take that job, when you take the Miami Heat job, when you take a job where there's a lot of talent, the expectation is to win championships.”

Shaquille O'Neal on JJ Redick, Jul 3, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
“I grew up watching a lot of Ray Allen, JJ Redick, and Kyle Korver. Obviously, Steph [Curry] and Klay [Thompson] have kind of revolutionized the 3-point shot as well,”

Duncan Robinson on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Jan 3, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on JJ Redick
item.description:
“One thing about it, he [Redick] knows his s***.Also, on top of that, man, any time you can see a former player that played the game get an opportunity to go sit in that seat, you would love to see it.”

Kendrick Perkins on JJ Redick, May 13, 2023. Source: TMZ.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on JJ Redick
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I think our game has taken a hit due to the lies that surround this game, due to the narratives that are driven that may not quite be true. AndI think players are pushing back on lies. You see JJ Redick on ESPN everyday telling that truth and killing these fake narratives that are put around this game. So I didn’t take CJ’s comment last night personal at all. It’s just him talking s***, me talking s*** and we keep it moving. There’s not a lot of honesty in this business anymore. And I think what players are bringing it back like CJ, like myself, like JJ Redick, who just retired two months ago and Pat Beverley. I think what players are bringing back to this is the truth. I love it.”

Draymond Green on JJ Redick, Jun 9, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Kira Lewis
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Stan Van Gundy on Kira Lewis and Nickeil Alexander-Walker with JJ Redick sidelined:

“Just like with the rest of our team, we want to see them do a good job defensively. They need to bring us a lot of energy. (No) added pressure on them; they're just going to get opportunity.”

Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Kira Lewis, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Josh Hart
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Stan Van Gundy on bench:

“Josh (Hart) played well today. JJ (Redick) played really well Wednesday. We've had good production out of those two guys. But I haven't given any other guys a CHANCE (to play significant minutes).That's on me. I've got to start using those guys more.”

Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Josh Hart, Dec 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Paul George on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Doc Rivers
item.description:
Paul George on his struggles in Doc Rivers' system:

“Doc was trying to play me as a Ray Allen or a JJ Redick, all pin-downs. I can do it, but that ain't my game. I need some flow, I need some mixes of some pick-and-roll, and post ups... That last season was hard.”

Paul George on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Doc Rivers, Dec 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Desmond Bane on JJ Redick, Ben Simmons, Landry Shamet
item.description:
“Obviously the attention that Ben Simmons and (Joel) Embiid demand is huge, so guys like me are very valuable that can play off the ball and make shots, have similar success to JJ Redick and Landry Shamet in previous years, running off screens. I feel like I can provide some of those same things.”

Desmond Bane on JJ Redick, Ben Simmons, Landry Shamet, Oct 8, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Kevin Durant on JJ Redick
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Kevin Durant on JJ Redick's podcast on picking the #Nets:

“Around February as I was thinking I didn’t want to be the savior of the #Knicks or New York. I didn’t care about being the King of New York. That never moved me. I didn’t care about being on Broadway, that (crap)...”

Kevin Durant on JJ Redick, Sep 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on JJ Redick
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Alvin Gentry on JJ Redick:

“I just think he’s a pro. I’ve coached him before and nothing has changed. He’s going to be prepared physically. He prepares mentally. He loves playing. He’s a joy to coach because of the passion that he plays with.”

Alvin Gentry on JJ Redick, Nov 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Brett Brown on JJ Redick
item.description:
#Sixers coach Brett Brown on the team’s shooting:

“I think we have shooter here. Are they at the standard of JJ Redick? No. But if you are looking at the bar, that’s pretty high.”

Brett Brown on JJ Redick, Oct 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Tobias Harris on JJ Redick, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Sixers ownerJosh Harris on the future of Jimmy Butler, Tobias Harris & JJ Redick beyond this postseason run:

“I'm hopeful that they'll be playing with us for a long, long time.”

Tobias Harris on JJ Redick, Jimmy Butler, Apr 13, 2019. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Reggie Bullock on JJ Redick
item.description:
Reggie Bullock on finding out he was starting in #Lakers debut:

“I found out in yesterday's practice that he had put me in to guard one of their aggressive players that's coming off a lot of handoffs & stuff, which is J.J. [Redick]...”

Reggie Bullock on JJ Redick, Feb 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Caron Butler on JJ Redick, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Caron Butler (@Caron Butler) on 76ers-Wolves trade:

“I like what Philadelphia did, acquiring Jimmy Butler. They need another shooter besides JJ Redick. They just need 1 more spacer. They have playmaking, which is key. They have a realistic chance to come out of the East though.”

Caron Butler on JJ Redick, Jimmy Butler, Nov 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Brett Brown on JJ Redick
item.description:
Brett Brown on whether it’s a priority to bring JJ Redick back:

“I love coaching JJ Redick. I really hope I can coach him again. I think the city and certainly his teammates understand what he brings to the table. Everyone gets the benefits that Joel Embiid and Ben Simmons have when they play with somebody like that. I really hope I can coach him again.”

Brett Brown on JJ Redick, Jun 16, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Joel Embiid on JJ Redick
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Embiid on Redick's defense:

“Honestly, I thought it was going to be trash, but he's been pretty good.”

Joel Embiid on JJ Redick, Dec 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Blake Griffin on JJ Redick, Jamal Crawford
item.description:
Griffin told The Vertical.

“With Chris gone, it changed our dynamic. For me, of course, I can look at it: I have the responsibility on my shoulder – all season. I have to do it. When Chris sat out, I was able to show it. I want to prove that I can sustain that style of play. Chris was one person, but we also lost J.J. [Redick], who I knew going into the free-agency process wouldn’t be back, Jamal [Crawford], who I thought we’d keep this summer but we had to move him around. So part of our core guys separated and that affected us. It changed the philosophy and we had to be accepting of the challenge.”

Blake Griffin on JJ Redick, Jamal Crawford, Oct 27, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
